name: TailingsFacilityMonitor
tagline: TSF instruments, TARP trigger levels, inspections, EoR actions and GISTM conformance in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete tailings storage facility surveillance module for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages: piezometer, prism, freeboard and seepage readings against rising or falling TARP levels, a safety state per facility, a TARP response board, inspections with follow-up actions, Engineer-of-Record action verification and a GISTM conformance matrix. Built-in demo data; connect any table in a few clicks.
features: Rising and falling TARP trigger levels with configurable responses
Facility safety state with GISTM consequence classification
Record readings with live level, jump warning and note on rise
Acknowledge exceedances and notify the EoR
Inspections with condition, findings and follow-up actions
Desktop, tablet and phone layouts, keyboard and screen-reader support
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform library, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (2 controls: dataset + Power Pages field control, shared src/app)
